<h2 class="section-title">India Markets</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Banking sector drag:</strong> The Sensex and Nifty declined significantly as private sector lenders, including HDFC Bank, Axis Bank, and Kotak Mahindra Bank, faced selling pressure following mixed Q1 earnings reports.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMi--?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I3</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I9</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Liquidity conditions:</strong> RBI money market operations data indicates a net liquidity absorption of ₹84,420.18 crore as of July 19, reflecting ongoing central bank efforts to manage system liquidity.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMinAFBVV95cUxPREdNZGlkSEV0VHp0ZjZqclJEVTBzRDgtQUdTQzJLa0lRTGVoOGdQejJCSWlYSGFuNGdxRjg0X3ZlSl9KVEx1Qjc2NWlKaG1JLXF3RDBibE91c0QxUTZZbFJLRlZIcEM0VUJyYlM2T1Y3Qi1GSTBnUVc3LVA1ZndNdHlWVU9HdU85VXJYVU9zOEVPb1V1X1ZOMGhyMEE?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I11</a></span></li>
</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Global Cues</h2>
